unit: W21 Windows owned-server short-home/CreateProcess path hardening
scope: Windows CreateProcess path preflight and task-owned frozen server-home; no remote execution or engine launch in this unit.

prior_windows64_attempt.source: Main-agent-verified Windows6.4 metadata attempt, recorded in RESUME.json::windows_native_preflight.repaired_metadata_execution
prior_windows64_attempt.failure: WinError206 at CreateProcess; launcher 283 characters, cwd 240, command line 1371.
prior_windows64_attempt.stop_or_replay: NONE; old frozen candidate is historical and must not be replayed.

implementation: On Windows, OwnedServerLauncher passes the already validated command[0] as Popen(executable=...), avoiding CreateProcessW null-lpApplicationName module-token resolution; POSIX behavior is unchanged.

The W21 runner freezes an optional task-owned short server-home root and a unique 16-hex child; checks existing path components for symlinks/junctions/canonical escape; execute validates and uses the frozen path rather than a hardcoded replacement.

Prepare/runtime preflight derives the real session state digest and checks private launcher, cwd, runtime paths and command line with UTF-16 code-unit budgets; no session identity/symlink/owner/loopback rules or system policy were changed.
Schema V2 rejects old plans rather than silently changing their home path; path tampering and deep-root preflight failure are covered offline.

windows_path_budget.accepted_path_condition: strictly less than 260 units including NUL
windows_path_budget.limitation: APFS measurements are synthetic UTF-16 length accounting, not Windows execution evidence; parent-provided taskroot projection is likewise a preflight estimate.

verification.scope_note: Offline unit tests only; one pre-existing test-owned Python loopback fixture is exercised. No COMSOL, Java, SSH or Windows native action.
